issues.legal_issue: A notice proposing a master-plan modification is invalid when it is publicized through only one of the prescribed methods, and action taken pursuant to that notice is also invalid.
material_facts: A public notice proposed changing the land use of an area from residential to recreational.
The notice was published in local newspapers, but was not affixed in conspicuous public places in the locality or proclaimed by beat of drum.
The affected persons challenged the notice, and the appeal followed dismissal of their petition.
issues.conclusion: The appeal was allowed. Because the notice was published through only one of the prescribed methods, it was invalid, as was the action taken pursuant to it.
issues.legal_principle: Section 44 of the Delhi Development Act, 1957 requires a notice of a proposed master-plan modification to be made widely known in the affected locality by following any two of three prescribed methods: affixing copies in conspicuous public places, publication by beat of drum, or advertisement in a local newspaper. Compliance is mandatory; the authority may use more than two methods and the Secretary may choose additional means of publication. Statutory language must be read in context rather than by isolating a word. Khub Chand v. State of Rajasthan and Collector (District Magistrate), Allahabad v. Raja Ram Jaiswal were referred to.

predicates.master_plan_change_notice_challenge: The proceeding challenges a notice proposing a change to a master plan.
predicates.notice_rule_requires_two_methods: The applicable notice requirement calls for the notice to be publicized by at least two prescribed methods.
predicates.notice_publicized_by_only_one_method: The authority publicized the notice by just one of the prescribed methods.
predicates.notice_and_resulting_action_invalid: The notice and action taken pursuant to it are invalid.

issues.definition: When a master-plan change notice is challenged, the applicable requirement calls for at least two prescribed publication methods, and the authority used only one, the notice and action taken pursuant to it are invalid.
